title: Entry Level Data Scientist
description:
Entry Level Data Scientist
Entry Level Data Scientist 
 
 AAA is offering an exciting opportunity to join our Data Science team, where you'll gain hands-on experience using data to solve real-world problems. You'll work with our insurance department to develop pipelines, logics, reports, and models to improve our insurance products and our customer experience. 
   
 What You’ll Do 
 Build an understanding of insurance’s business operations, KPI’s and strategic goals 

 Develop and automate data pipelines and dashboards monitoring insurance products 

 Maintain documentation, validate ongoing data pipelines and implement anomaly detection and other data quality monitoring algorithms 

 Support development and implementation of AI capabilities into insurance operations 

 Productionize ML models for retention and sales improvement 

 What You’ll Need 
 Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited University or College with an emphasis on computer science, statistics, business analytics or a related subject area 

 Experience working with relational databases and coding in SQL 

 Experience coding in Python 

 Ability to communicate effectively in a variety of business-related contexts including in-person, video calls and email 

 Nice to Have 
 Working knowledge of insurance industry 

 Experience of working with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, GCP, and Snowflake 

 Graduate degree or data science certification
